# Isaiah Chapter 25 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 12 verses]*

*Thanksgiving; feast of rich food; death swallowed; tears wiped; Moab humbled*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** He will swallow up death forever, and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from all faces. This chapter thanksgiving.

*-- LOGOS*
